composition_challenge.criterion: PASS only if every model keeps composition-decoy acceptance < 10%
composition_challenge.note: decoy sequences are length+composition matched shuffles of the positives; a high acceptance rate means the model reads composition, not order

caveats: Positives are DRAMP-curated bacterial actives (TIER_B_LABEL: bacterial activity label + named target + PubMed reference). The bulk dumps do not carry per-record MIC values, so this is not a MIC-quantitative cohort.
Negatives are UniProt bacterial-cytoplasm fragments: a weak negative label, not experimentally verified inactivity.
The composition-matched challenge is reported as a challenge; a high flag rate is published as a failure mode, not hidden.
